**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

Section 18 of the agreement already carries a complete vendor insurance package that satisfies every preferred element of the INSURANCE rule:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§ 18.1)
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§ 18.1)
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5,000,000, stated unconditionally (§ 18.1), and Vendor does process Customer Data per § 17
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law (§ 18.1), plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra
- **Certificates** — provided on request (§ 18.2)

Additional terms in § 18.2 (reputable insurers, primary to our insurance, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, insurance not limiting Vendor's liabilities) run in our favour, and nothing elsewhere in the document qualifies or reduces these limits. No redline proposed.
